items.title: Git Patches Flaw That Lets Malicious Repositories Execute Code During Recursive Clones
items.summary: A flaw in Git can let a malicious repository run an attacker's code on a computer that clones it recursively, together with its submodules. The Git project fixed it this week in Git 2.56.1, with matching fixes for the 2.50 through 2.55 series in 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.
items.author: Swati Khandelwal
